summary: 12 English sentences about one's home to translate into Finnish practising minulla on / minulla ei ole + partitive, with a vocabulary list.
transcript:
MINULLA ON KIVA ASUNTO     (I HAVE A NICE FLAT)

1. I HAVE A MODERN KITCHEN BUT I DON’T HAVE A MICROWAVE.

2. I HAVE A SPACIOUS LIVING-ROOM AND A BIG, SOFT, COMFORTABLE LEATHER SOFA.

3. MY BEDROOM IS LIGHT AND TIDY. WE HAVE THREE WINDOWS.

4. MY BATHROOM IS REALLY SMALL. WE DON’T HAVE A BATHTUB. WE HAVE A SHOWER.

5. I DON’T HAVE A STUDY.

6. WE DON’T HAVE A SAUNA IN LONDON.

7. OUR TOILET IS CRAMPED AND THAT’S WHY IT IS MESSY.

8. DO YOU HAVE A BALCONY? WE DON’T HAVE A BALCONY.

9. WE DON’T HAVE A GARDEN BUT OUR FRONTYARD IS BIG AND GREEN.

10. WE HAVE TWO KIDS SO WE HAVE A SANDPIT AND A SWING.

11. I DON’T HAVE A CAR SO WE DON’T HAVE A GARAGE.

12. WE DON’T HAVE A PET. DO YOU HAVE A DOG OR A CAT?

MODERN=MODERNI KITCHEN=KEITTIÖ BUT=MUTTA MICROWAVE=MIKRO(AALTOUUNI)
SPACIOUS= TILAVA LIVING-ROOM=OLOHUONE BIG= ISO SOFT= PEHMEÄ COMFORTABLE= MUKAVA
LEATHER= NAHKA- SOFA= SOHVA BEDROOM=MAKUUHUONE LIGHT=VALOISA TIDY=SIISTI
WINDOW= IKKUNA BATHROOM=KYLPYHUONE REALLY=TOSI, TODELLA SMALL=PIENI
BATHTUB=KYLPYAMME SHOWER=SUIHKU STUDY= TYÖHUONE TOILET=VESSA CRAMPED=AHDAS
THAT’S WHY= SEN TAKIA MESSY= SEKAINEN BALCONY= PARVEKE GARDEN=PUUTARHA
FRONTYARD=ETUPIHA GREEN= VIHREÄ CHILD= LAPSI (PARTITIIVI: LASTA) SANDPIT=HIEKKALAATIKKO
SWING=KEINU CAR=AUTO GARAGE=AUTOTALLI PET = LEMMIKKI DOG= KOIRA OR= TAI CAT= KISSA

exercises.title: Minulla on kiva asunto (I have a nice flat)
exercises.instruction: Translate into Finnish (minulla on / minulla ei ole + partitive).

items.prompt: 1. I HAVE A MODERN KITCHEN BUT I DON'T HAVE A MICROWAVE.
items.answer: Minulla on moderni keittiö, mutta minulla ei ole mikroa.
items.en: I have a modern kitchen but i don't have a microwave.

items.prompt: 2. I HAVE A SPACIOUS LIVING-ROOM AND A BIG, SOFT, COMFORTABLE LEATHER SOFA.
items.answer: Minulla on tilava olohuone ja iso, pehmeä, mukava nahkasohva.
items.en: I have a spacious living-room and a big, soft, comfortable leather sofa.

items.prompt: 3. MY BEDROOM IS LIGHT AND TIDY. WE HAVE THREE WINDOWS.
items.answer: Minun makuuhuone on valoisa ja siisti. Meillä on kolme ikkunaa.
items.en: My bedroom is light and tidy. we have three windows.

items.prompt: 4. MY BATHROOM IS REALLY SMALL. WE DON'T HAVE A BATHTUB. WE HAVE A SHOWER.
items.answer: Minun kylpyhuone on tosi pieni. Meillä ei ole kylpyammetta. Meillä on suihku.
items.en: My bathroom is really small. we don't have a bathtub. we have a shower.

items.prompt: 6. WE DON'T HAVE A SAUNA IN LONDON.
items.en: We don't have a sauna in london.

items.prompt: 7. OUR TOILET IS CRAMPED AND THAT'S WHY IT IS MESSY.
items.answer: Meidän vessa on ahdas ja sen takia se on sekainen.
items.en: Our toilet is cramped and that's why it is messy.

items.prompt: 8. DO YOU HAVE A BALCONY? WE DON'T HAVE A BALCONY.
items.answer: Onko sinulla parveke? Meillä ei ole parveketta.
items.en: Do you have a balcony? we don't have a balcony.

items.prompt: 9. WE DON'T HAVE A GARDEN BUT OUR FRONTYARD IS BIG AND GREEN.
items.answer: Meillä ei ole puutarhaa, mutta meidän etupiha on iso ja vihreä.
items.en: We don't have a garden but our frontyard is big and green.

items.prompt: 10. WE HAVE TWO KIDS SO WE HAVE A SANDPIT AND A SWING.
items.answer: Meillä on kaksi lasta, joten meillä on hiekkalaatikko ja keinu.
items.en: We have two kids so we have a sandpit and a swing.

items.prompt: 11. I DON'T HAVE A CAR SO WE DON'T HAVE A GARAGE.
items.answer: Minulla ei ole autoa, joten meillä ei ole autotallia.
items.en: I don't have a car so we don't have a garage.

items.prompt: 12. WE DON'T HAVE A PET. DO YOU HAVE A DOG OR A CAT?
items.answer: Meillä ei ole lemmikkiä. Onko sinulla koira tai kissa?
items.en: We don't have a pet. do you have a dog or a cat?
